activation_rule: The new no-control reference must run first and pass every broad alpha, cost, regime, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, A5 score, and concentration gate. A failed reference terminates the family; none of these drafts may search for a rescue.

material_trials.purpose: measure the common market-state contribution to bull and bear construction
measure whether causal market-state adaptation improves regime breadth
test whether slow common trend prevents fast whipsaw
test whether fast common trend improves reversal timing

registration_rule: Every activated row requires a separately materialized source identity and preregistration before execution.
